author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
ChatGPT Work vs Claude Cowork vs Copilot Cowork

Who will win the battle of billion dollars market of white collar AI agent?

I tried all three, so far, I like ChatGPT Work better. Copilot Cowork has its limitation, but what I see as constrains as an engineer is exactly its strength deploying to non-tech workers.

For, Claude Cowork, Anthropic, you guys should stop vibe coding all your products. Please bring some humans back in the loop, especially in QA.
